bio: Adrian Asiedu Boafo (born May 10, 1994) is an American politician who is the member-elect of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 5th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates from the 23rd district in Prince George's County, Maryland, since 2023.
